title: Cited Photo Archive Registry — Photo Registry 232
description: The registry of CultureTechLens' 232 published Cited Photo Archive evidence cards: per photo, registry ID, title, photographer, source, rights statement, what it documents, the citation as published, page/file URLs, and an AEO question and answer. All 232 rows are rights-stated (119 public domain; the rest CC and CC0); none uncleared. Extracted verbatim from culturetechlens.com/photos/ on 2026-11-04 and governed by CTL-PHOTO-001/002. Distinct from the internal Photo Rights Log v4 — the two are never merged.
notes: Pre-publication package (v1.0 assembled 2026-11-16 from the 2026-11-04 extraction). Zenodo deposit pending the founder's token sitting; no DOI yet. Per-photo rights are recorded per row and are not changed by the dataset license.
